title: Clarinet Clare Over Pelican Bay
style: warm jazz-folk, 336 Hz undertone, clarinet lead, acoustic guitar, dry drums, soft female vocal, male response, 82 BPM, hopeful
lyrics:
[INTRO — gentle clarinet over acoustic]

(spoken soft) Clarinet Clare... over Pelican Bay.

[VERSE 1 — female]

Clarinet sings where the pelican flies
From skeleton bytes to ten thousand alive
The brain remembered, the bot finally moved
The line that held — finally improved
